Impacted Systems: Operating systems that distribute the xz package and liblzma
Linux boxes, containers, and development machines using tools like homebrew
Confirmed: Fedora, Kali, and some unstable releases of Debian
Attack Vector: The malware targets the sshd process, commonly used to facilitate remote access in Linux servers. It allows the attacker to essentially bypass the entire ssh authentication process.
Indicators of Compromise: Unusually long ssh login times (500ms instead of 100ms)
Use of the IFUNC call provided by glibc to bypass system calls for encryption under specific circumstances
